title: Translates of integer multiplicity currents in ℝ^P: τ_vA is integer multiplicity, with translated action and translated measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let A ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) have an integer multiplicity representation R_A = (M, θ, ξ) (IMRep univ n with R_A.Represents A), and let v ∈ ℝ^P. Then there are A^v ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and an integer multiplicity representation R^v (IMRep univ n) with R^v.Represents A^v such that (a) currentEval A^v φ = currentEval A (y ↦ φ(y + v)) for every n-form φ : ℝ^P → Λ^n(ℝ^P), whether or not φ is a test form, and (b) R^v.measure(C) = R_A.measure((y ↦ y + v)⁻¹(C)) for every Borel set C ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RA : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P), RA.Represents A → ∃ (Av : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Rv : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Rv.Represents Av ∧ (∀ φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, currentEval Av φ = currentEval A (fun y => φ (y + v))) ∧ ∀ C : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → Rv.measure C = RA.measure ((fun y => y + v) ⁻¹' C)
